methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the main indicators of energy performance management systems. In this way, a new model is proposed to make a priority analysis for the hospitals.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Decision-support prioritisation model; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The most significant methodological novelty of this study is proposing a new technique to the literature named RATGOS.

stage1.notes: The paper ranks ISO 50006-derived management indicators and G7 countries via fuzzy MCDM; it does not model or normalise organisational energy use.
